Store is about to be shared between the threads of a web server. Make src/inventory/store.py safe to use from several threads at once: concurrent calls to add, quantity and items must never corrupt the store or raise, and items() must return a consistent snapshot (every item from one moment, sorted by SKU) that later changes do not affect. Keep the public API and its behaviour for single-threaded callers exactly as they are, and add tests that call the store from many threads at once.
